_note: Cost guardrail for the quality loop: the 'baseline' bench run of 2026-10-17 (commit 90a637a) plus a noise allowance: +10% on GPU/frame timings (two identical runs differ by ~5-10%), +15% on SwiftShader timings (only ~220 frames), +3% on deterministic counts and sizes. Hitches (>50 ms frames) are reported but not gated: the few seen are one-off shader-compile spikes. The deterministic counts and the SwiftShader timings are the real gate (the M4 is barely loaded at ~550 fps); M4 timings are a tie-breaker. Quality changes may not push any metric past its limit. Metric paths refer to build/bench/<label>/stats-<profile>.json.
